entries.subject: May et al. (2022)'s Spitzer 4.5 um phase curve (wa140bo21) as a map of longitude
entries.finding: Read on 2026-10-15. The preferred fit is the asymmetric (second-order) phase function (Delta BIC 6.2 below the symmetric one), printed only as an amplitude of 624 +/- 80 ppm and an offset of -55.7 +/- 28.3 degrees, which do not determine a second-order curve. Its night side (1201 +/- 29 K) reads warmer than its day side (1169 +/- 25 K); the paper finds a phase curve only with its fixed sensitivity map, a free BLISS map preferring a flat one, and notes the orbit is eccentric (e = 0.047) and may not be synchronous.
entries.revisitWhen: A new phase curve of WASP-140 b, or a paper printing the asymmetric fit's terms.
